entities.summary: Three main sets of works are attributed to Florus : Virgilius orator an poeta, the Epitome of Roman History and a collection of 14 short poems. As to whether these were composed by the same person, or set of people, is unclear, but the works are variously attributed to:Publius Annius Florus, described as a Roman poet and rhetorician. Julius Florus, described as an ancient Roman poet, orator, and author who was born around 74 AD and died around 130 AD Florus was born in Africa, but raised in Rome. Lucius Annaeus Florus, a Roman historian, who lived in the time of Trajan and Hadrian and was also born in Africa.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Lucius Annaeus Florus was a Roman historian who lived during the reign of Trajan and Hadrian, providing valuable insights into the history of Rome. His works, including the Epitome of Roman History, offer a unique perspective on the Roman Empire's development.
